article.title: Xi Jinping calls for complete ban and destruction of nuclear weapons, with ultimate goal of nuclear-free world
article.author: Editor
article.content: According to CCTV News, Xi set out four principles at the meeting for how major powers should manage their relations and jointly safeguard world peace: mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, mutually beneficial cooperation, and dialogue and consultation. The post Xi Jinping calls for complete ban and destruction of nuclear weapons, with ultimate goal of nuclear-free world appeared first on MR Online .
